parameters.name: ContainerGroupIds
parameters.description: A sequence of ECI instance IDs. You can specify up to 20 instance IDs. The character string must be passed in JSON format.

parameters.name: EventSource
parameters.description:
The event source. Valid values:

- EciService
- K8sAgent

Default value: empty, which indicates that all events are queried.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description:
The maximum number of resources (ECI instances) to return. Default value: 200.

> The number of returned results may be less than the specified value but never exceeds it.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token for the next query. If NextToken is empty, no more results exist.

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, obtain the token from the response of the previous query.

parameters.name: SinceSecond
parameters.description: Returns events that occurred within the specified number of seconds. This parameter is used for polling incremental events.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags bound to the ECI instances.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the ECI instance.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the ECI instance.
